name: yildun
description: The writing partner for the HOSL writing-partner study: the writer's document and Accept/Modify/Reject log build together in the desktop app, with the weekly check-in and a push to the study repository built in.
long_description: Ten tools: open, read, save, and append the writer's piece; log each Accept/Modify/Reject decision in the shared study schema; report writing status; run the voice gate; run and save the weekly check-in; and commit and push the writer's folder so the term survives a lost laptop. Python 3 standard library only.

tools.name: open_piece
tools.description: Create or open the writer's document.

tools.name: save_piece
tools.description: Overwrite the document after a logged decision.

tools.name: append_piece
tools.description: Append to the document after a logged decision.

tools.name: log_decision
tools.description: Record one Accept/Modify/Reject decision, in the writer's words.

tools.name: writing_status
tools.description: Word count and the running decision tally.

tools.name: check_piece
tools.description: Run the voice gate on the document.

tools.name: checkin_start
tools.description: Begin the weekly check-in: tally and prompts.

tools.name: checkin_save
tools.description: Save the weekly check-in from the writer's answers.

tools.name: sync_work
tools.description: Commit and push the writer's folder.

author.title: Your author name
author.description: Stamped on every decision you log. Set once; it cannot be added to old entries later.

work_folder.title: Your work folder
work_folder.description: Your folder inside the study repository clone, for example students/<you>. Your document, log, and check-ins are written here and pushed from here.
